Every environment variable the `codify` package reads, found by reading its source for `os.environ` and `os.getenv` calls and the command line's own lookup helper. The command line also loads the nearest `.env` file without overriding a variable that is already set. A blank default means the code has no fallback value at that read.

## Runtime

| Variable | Default in code | Read in | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ACQUISITION_INDEX_DIR` | `data/datadumps` | `codify.acquisition.index` | Directory holding each jurisdiction's built acquisition index, as `<dir>/<jurisdiction>/index.json`. |
| `ACQUISITION_USER_AGENT` | empty string | `codify.acquisition.base` | User-Agent every acquisition and URL-ingest request carries, naming you and a contact; unset, those requests stop with an error. |
| `AZURE_FOUNDRY_OCR_RPM` | `40` | `codify.cli` | Requests per minute allowed to the direct Azure OCR endpoint in `ingest-one`. |
| `AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY` |  | `codify.cli` | Key for the direct Azure OCR endpoint; with `AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT` set, `ingest-one` can route transcription there. |
| `AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT` | empty string | `codify.cli` | Azure endpoint whose host `ingest-one` uses to build the direct OCR address; needs `AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY` as well. |
| `CODIFY_DATA_ROOT` |  | `codify.data_paths` | Absolute path to a directory holding the `data/` folders (such as `jurisdictions`) in place of the ones found beside the package. |
| `CODIFY_RELEASE` | `dev` | `codify.core.tracing` | Release name attached to traces. |
| `EE_DATADUMP_ZIP` |  | `codify.acquisition.adapters.ee.datadump` | Path to the bulk XML archive the `ee` datadump acquirer reads when none is passed in code. |
| `EMBEDDING_API_KEY` | built-in value | `codify.cli_store` | Key for the embeddings endpoint; falls back to `LLM_API_KEY`. |
| `EMBEDDING_BASE_URL` |  | `codify.cli_store` | OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint for `load --embed`, `search`, the HTTP server and the MCP server; falls back to `LLM_BASE_URL`. |
| `EMBEDDING_MODEL` | `gemini-embedding-2` | `codify.cli_store` | Embedding model name sent to the embeddings endpoint. |
| `ENVIRONMENT` |  | `codify.migrations.env`, `codify.settings` | Deployment name; unless it is empty, `localhost` or `development`, an unset `POSTGRES_URL` is an error instead of falling back to the local database. |
| `EU_DATADUMP_ZIP` |  | `codify.acquisition.adapters.eu.datadump` | Path to the bulk FORMEX archive the EU acquirer reads when none is passed in code. |
| `LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY` |  | `codify.cli` | Langfuse tracing key; when it is unset the CLI silences the Langfuse SDK's warnings. |
| `LLM_API_KEY` | built-in value | `codify.cli`, `codify.cli_store` | Key for the chat endpoint at `LLM_BASE_URL`. |
| `LLM_BASE_URL` |  | `codify.cli`, `codify.cli_store`, `codify.serve.app` | OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint used by `ingest-one`, `compare` and the servers; `ingest-one` stops with an error when it is unset. |
| `LLM_CONTENT_FILTER_FALLBACK_MODEL` | empty string | `codify.cli` | Default for `ingest-one --fallback-model`, the model retried when a call is refused by a content filter. |
| `LLM_MODEL` | `gemini-3.7-flash` | `codify.cli`, `codify.cli_store` | Default chat model for `ingest-one --model`, `compare` and the servers. |
| `LLM_OCR_MODEL` | empty string | `codify.cli` | Default for `ingest-one --ocr-model`, the transcription engine; empty uses the vision route on the chat model. |
| `POSTGRES_URL` |  | `codify.eval.synthetic_retrieval`, `codify.migrations.env`, `codify.settings`, `codify.testing` | Database connection URL; unset, the local compose database, but only where `ENVIRONMENT` is local or development. |
| `QBZ_AUTH` | built-in value | `codify.acquisition.adapters.al.qbz` | Authorisation value the `al` QBZ acquirer sends with every request, in place of its built-in public token. |
| `SSL_CERT_DIR` |  | `codify.acquisition.politeness` | Directory of CA certificates the polite HTTP client trusts, read when `SSL_CERT_FILE` is unset. |
| `SSL_CERT_FILE` |  | `codify.acquisition.politeness` | CA bundle the polite HTTP client trusts in place of the bundled certificates. |

## Tests and evaluation

Read only by the test and evaluation helpers.

| Variable | Default in code | Read in | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CODIFY_TEST_RUN_ID` |  | `codify.testing` | Pins the identifier the test helpers use to name per-run databases; set automatically outside pytest-xdist. |
| `CODIFY_TEST_SHARE_DB` |  | `codify.testing` | Set to `1` to make pytest-xdist workers share the base test database instead of each cloning their own. |
| `OLLAMA_HOST` | `http://localhost:11434` | `codify.testing` | Address of a local Ollama server for the test helpers. |
| `PYTEST_XDIST_TESTRUNUID` |  | `codify.testing` | Set by pytest-xdist; the test helpers use it to name one database per test run. |
| `PYTEST_XDIST_WORKER` |  | `codify.testing` | Set by pytest-xdist; the test helpers give each worker its own database. |

## Names taken from configuration

These modules read a variable whose name comes from data, not code: a source adapter's `auth_env_var` in the [jurisdiction config](jurisdiction-config.md). `codify.jurisdictions`.
